article.content:
**Dediščina, 14. 10. 2026.** The iPhone 17 Pro introduces a powerful new 48MP Pro Fusion camera system, giving you sharp, detailed photos no matter which lens you use. The Main, Ultra Wide, and Telephoto cameras all shoot at 48MP, so your pictures stay consistent in quality whether you're zoomed in or out. The new Telephoto lens reaches an impressive 200mm focal length with 8x optical-quality zoom – that's the longest zoom ever on an iPhone. It means you can capture distant subjects clearly without relying on digital zoom or carrying extra lenses, opening up new creative possibilities for your photography.
